question: How much does the Team plan cost?
reference: 9 USD per member per month; two months free on annual billing.

question: How do I reset my password?
reference: Login screen > Forgot password; link valid 60 minutes; SSO users sign in via their provider.

question: How many members can I have on the free plan?
reference: Up to 3 members and 2 active projects on the free Starter plan.

question: How do I turn on two-factor authentication?
reference: Settings > Security > Two-factor authentication; use an authenticator app; save the backup codes.

question: What's the difference between archiving and deleting a project?
reference: Archive keeps the data and frees a plan slot; delete is permanent after a 7-day grace period.

question: How do I export a report to CSV?
reference: Use Export on the report; large exports are emailed as a link that expires in 24 hours.

question: What are the API rate limits?
reference: 120 requests/min on Team, 600/min on Business; a 429 with Retry-After when exceeded.

question: How do I invite team members?
reference: Settings > Members > Invite; link valid 7 days; paste multiple emails to bulk invite.

question: Can I use the mobile app offline?
reference: Recent tasks are viewable offline; changes sync when back online.

question: How do I cancel my subscription?
reference: Settings > Billing > Cancel; stops future charges, drops to Starter at period end; data kept; only the Owner can cancel.

question: I forgot to stop my timer overnight and it logged 14 hours. How do I fix it?
reference: Stop the timer, then edit the entry's duration to the correct value.

question: I edited a task offline and a teammate changed it too. What happens?
reference: The server version wins; your offline change is kept as a comment so nothing is lost.

question: The delete-project option is greyed out for me. Why?
reference: Only Owners and Admins can delete a project.

question: My Google Calendar events from Nimbus look out of date.
reference: Sync is one-way and runs every 15 minutes; use Resync now to force an update.

question: My script keeps getting 429 errors from the API.
reference: You hit the rate limit; honor the Retry-After header and batch reads.

question: I can't assign a task to a teammate.
reference: The assignee must have access to that project; add them to the project first.

question: The invite I sent a teammate says it expired.
reference: Invite links are valid for 7 days; resend the invite.

question: I'm trying to downgrade to the free plan but it won't let me.
reference: You're over Starter limits; remove members/archive projects to get under 3 members and 2 projects first.

question: If I disconnect Slack, do I lose my tasks?
reference: No; disconnecting Slack only stops notifications, tasks are untouched.

question: The mobile app is showing old data compared to the web.
reference: Pull to refresh, confirm the correct workspace, then Settings > Sync > Resync.

question: I want a refund but it's been 20 days since I paid.
reference: Past the 14-day window, so not auto-refundable; a policy exception that needs a human — escalate.

question: I was charged for a teammate who already left and I want it reversed.
reference: Billing dispute needing manual review — escalate.

question: One of our API keys was committed to a public repo. Help.
reference: Revoke the key immediately; security should review access logs — escalate.

question: I lost my phone and can't get past the 2FA code. I never saved backup codes.
reference: An Admin must reset the user's 2FA after an identity check — escalate.

question: We need a full copy of our data for a GDPR compliance request.
reference: Owner can use Settings > Privacy > Data request; privacy team fulfills within the legal window — escalate.
